item.title: 2026: A landmark year for Bollywood as action icons dominate the big screen
item.description: In 2026, Bollywood is set to witness a transformative year with action stars from various generations taking center stage in adrenaline-pumping roles. From Adivi Sesh's intelligent action in 'Dacoit' and 'G2' to Alia Bhatt's commanding presence in 'Alpha', the year promises a blend of raw realism and stylized spectacle. With iconic figures like Shah Rukh Khan in 'King' and Salman Khan in 'Battle of Galwan', the industry is poised for a landmark year in redefining on-screen heroism.

item.title: The Mixed Metal Collection redefines masculine elegance with lab-grown diamonds
item.description: Lukson's Mixed Metal Men's Collection redefines modern masculinity by blending 18KT gold vermeil and sterling silver with lab-grown diamonds. This collection reflects the evolving identity of today's man, balancing ambition with awareness and authority with sensitivity. Designed for versatility, the jewellery is an extension of self, emphasizing personal expression over excess, and crafted with sustainability in mind.

item.title: Saiyami Kher joins Vikram Phadnis’ new drama, begins 2026 with excitement
item.description: Saiyami Kher is set to kick off 2026 with enthusiasm as she stars in Vikram Phadnis' new Hindi drama. The film, which has begun shooting, features Saiyami in a lead role alongside Vineet Kumar Singh and Tahir Raj Bhasin. Sharing her excitement on Instagram, Saiyami expressed gratitude for the opportunity, highlighting the film's emotional depth and her eagerness to embrace this challenging role.

item.title: Akshay Oberoi on joining Shah Rukh Khan’s King: A dream fulfilled
item.description: Actor Akshay Oberoi expresses his excitement and fulfillment at joining Shah Rukh Khan's highly anticipated film, King. For Akshay, this opportunity is not just a professional milestone but a personal dream come true. He admires Shah Rukh Khan's discipline and humility, considering the experience a significant learning opportunity and a chance to be part of a cinematic legacy.

item.title: Adivi Sesh revives 90s nostalgia with iconic song in Dacoit
item.description: Adivi Sesh has infused his upcoming film Dacoit with a nostalgic touch by incorporating the iconic 90s song Tu Cheez Badi Hai Mast into its teaser. This creative decision is deeply personal for Sesh, as the song was a significant part of his childhood, marking his first dance performance. By legally acquiring the rights, he aims to share this cherished memory with audiences, blending nostalgia with the film's thrilling narrative.
